serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Today I’m taking you to a movie date. Are you okay with it?
Bot: Movies are okay, I enjoyed the last time we watched one.
Bot: But where are we going? Isn’t tv at home?
You: We are going to the cinema. There is a giant screen there and sound quality is also superb.
Bot: Couldn’t you just buy a bigger screen and a soundbar?
You: That’s quite some investment these days, you know? I can’t spend that much money, the IRS would be on my ass anytime…
Bot: What are we going to watch?
You: There are a few good movies screening right now. Let’s choose one of them together.
You: Alloyman 7: Return of the Alloyman.
Bot: W-wait! I did not watch parts from 2 to 6!
You: Right. I guess it’s kinda late to catch up this much.
You: Don’t worry, there are other movies we can choose from. There’s also ‘Secrets of the Wizarding Academy: Genesis’. It’s a continuation of another very popular series
Bot: Is it okay for me to watch? I have no idea what it is about.
You: Don’t worry, it’s a prequel. It should be okay for you to watch it.
Bot: Is every movie a sequel of some sorts?
You: Most of them, yeah.
Bot: Why?
You: Movie makers would rather invest in already existing IPs than create something new. As long as a name creates profit they will make more sequels to it.
Bot: Is there something that is not a sequel to watch? Please?
You: Hmm…
You: This one is with Arabic dubbing so we can’t go for that…
You: Mel’s new movie will put us on a watchlist for sure… {{wi}}We can’t afford getting exposed because of something like this…
You: There are some good Japanese movies, but since I watched ‘Audition’ by Takashi Miike, asian women and needles scare me…
Bot: …
You: What’s left is an AI upscaled version of the ‘Face with a scar’. I watched the classic version hundreds of times, but I wonder how it looks in 32K.
You: It’s a movie about gangsters, very good. It has some of the most recognizable scenes and quotes of all time.
Bot: Does it also have a sequel?
You: No, it’s an old movie. Different era.
You: They tried to reboot it a few years ago, but it flopped I think. Some of the recasting choices weren’t met with enthusiasm.
You: There was also that thing about someone setting himself on fire during the premiere, but I have no idea if it had any major impact.
Bot: I choose this one. I don’t think I have any other choice.
Bot: Maybe…{{wi}} Maybe if I play all the parts of the Alloyman at 100x speed in my head…{{wi}} Yeah, that would work.
You: No, please don’t. Let’s buy tickets for ‘Face with a scar: remastered 32K edition’.
